hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r ".tool_input.command // empty"); case "$cmd" in *"git commit"*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; hash=$(git -C "$root" log -1 --format=%h 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; log="$root/docs/WORKLOG.md"; grep -q "($hash)" "$log" 2>/dev/null && exit 0; mkdir -p "$root/docs"; echo "- $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M') — $(git -C "$root" log -1 --format=%s) ($hash)" >> "$log" || true
